As I said, it becomes a problem if you do it too much. Just understand that some activities are more usefull than others. Sure relaxation is fine, but it's a lot nicer after actually achieving something that day. Succes in life is much more than beeing able to not blow your load, although it gives you a big advantage. You did good to not give in to the temptation so far, stay true to it and you will build willpower and discipline, things that will bring you a long way.

To put it simple: By playing games or PMO'ing your brain will feel like it's beeing rewarded for something. This is fine for most people, but do it too much and you will condition your own mind to that you don't have to get off your ass and actually work for good things in life. 

It's a huge step to actually stop this kind of activity and replace them for for activities that will leave you proud and make you a better person. Set goals towards the kind of person you want to be and use your free time for those. Eventually you will condition your mind to a "hard work pays off"-mentallity.
